title: Incorrect Combined Filters and Pagination
business_scenario: Customer applies brand, price range, category, and rating filters while navigating through catalog pages.
symptoms: Certain products matching the filters disappear, total page counts are computed on the unfiltered collection, and page 2 returns empty results prematurely.
reproduction_steps: Observe missing items and incorrect totalItems count.
expected_behavior: Filtering must be applied to the complete dataset first; pagination offset slicing must occur only on the filtered list.
actual_behavior: Pagination slice is taken from the unfiltered dataset before filtering, discarding valid matching items that fall outside the initial slice.
root_cause: products.service.js slices db.products prior to filtering, rather than filtering the entire array and then slicing.
acceptance_criteria: The sum of items across all paginated pages must exactly equal the total number of items matching the filter criteria.
reference_fix: Filter all products first, sort deterministically, calculate totalPages based on filtered length, and then slice for the requested page.
regression_tests: Unfiltered pagination correctly traverses all items page by page.
